Select distinct molecule ChEMBL identifiers and canonical SMILES for compounds tested against the human adenosine A2a receptor. Join molecule_dictionary to activities, then assays, then target_dictionary to match the target. Join compound_structures to retrieve canonical SMILES. Filter by target_dictionary.pref_name = 'adenosine A2a receptor' and target_dictionary.organism = 'Homo sapiens'. Return columns named compound_chembl_id and canonical_smiles. Sort by compound_chembl_id.
